# Nexora Semiconductor (Nexora Semi)

> Nexora Semiconductor Pty Ltd (trading as Nexora Semi) is an early-stage fabless semiconductor company in Adelaide, South Australia. It is developing precision timing integrated circuits (1.2 V, 1.8 V and 3.3 V oscillator ICs, PLL oscillator ICs, OCXO controller ICs, clock generators and jitter cleaners) on a reusable mixed-signal platform, using an AI agent-driven design flow in which a senior designer directs AI agents that generate, simulate, lay out and verify circuits.

## Key facts

- Business model: fabless. Nexora designs chips; foundry partners manufacture them.
- Products (in development): oscillator ICs and PLL oscillator ICs (first focus); OCXO controller ICs, clock generators and jitter cleaners (roadmap); customer-specific timing variants for partners.
- Target markets: telecommunications, optical networking, GNSS, wireless/IoT modules, industrial electronics, test and measurement.
- Core technology: an AI agent-driven design flow. Agents operate chip-design tools by script across schematic, simulation, layout and verification. A senior designer reviews and signs off every stage.

## Results to date (block level, 2026)

- About 15 analog blocks laid out by AI agents and verified DRC/LVS-clean in about two weeks.
- Automated layout, verification and corner/Monte Carlo simulation.

## Status and roadmap

- Completed (2026): AI design flow built and proven on circuit blocks; company established.
- In progress: full-chip integration.
- Planned: first precision-timing ASIC (oscillator platform) on a multi-project wafer shuttle; silicon characterisation; engineering samples.
